Subject: [VOTE] Release Apache Cassandra Python Driver 3.31.0

Greetings all!  I'm proposing the test build of Cassandra Python Driver
3.31.0 for release.


Git commit sha1 for this release: 25393c2e709a353aebb8219c8bfbe60accb7bcc2

Git: https://github.com/apache/cassandra-python-driver/releases/tag/3.31.0

Source release:

https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/cassandra/cassandra-python-driver/3.31.0/

Changelog:

https://github.com/apache/cassandra-python-driver/blob/3.31.0/CHANGELOG.rst#3310


3.31.0 is a small update to add explicit support for Python 3.15 and drop
support for Python 3.10.  Our hope is that this is the last release in the
3.x line with Python driver 4.0 arriving to replace it.


For sake of convenience we’re following roughly the same release process
used for 3.30.1.  Wheels for this release can be found in SVN [1].  As a
convenience for testing I've also deployed this release as 3.31.0rc1 [2] on
testpypi [3] .  You can install this package from testpypi via the
following sequence of commands:


uv pip install deprecated # necessary because transitive dependencies
aren't available on testpypi

uv pip install --index-url “https://test.pypi.org/simple/
<https://test.pypi.org/simple/>” cassandra-driver==3.31.0rc1


3.31.0rc1 follows Python naming conventions [4] for pre-releases.  The
content of 3.31.0rc1 is identical to 3.31.0 with the exception of an
additional commit which changes the version.  This can be confirmed by
viewing the corresponding tag [5].


The vote will be open for 72 hours (longer if needed) until ~9pm GMT on 19
November 2026. Everyone who has tested the build is invited to vote.  Votes
by PMC members are considered binding. A vote passes if there are at least
three binding +1s and no -1's.


Thanks all!


- Bret -
